items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: Yeah. Yeah, yeah. Well, I played with him with, uh, with the, with the first... Who else was in the band? Joe Howard. Joe Howard, yeah.

ctx.x: Baby just died, you know, a couple months ago. Yeah, sure enough. In Chicago.
Uh-huh. And, uh, he had, uh, Leonard, I think, on, on, on Get There. Let's see. And Joe Howard had a trumpet. Oh. And Eddie Atkin on the, on the trombone. And, uh, I was on, uh, clarinet.

Do you remember, did the, was Eddie, uh, Dorsey or Dawson ever in the band there? Eddie Dorsey? Yeah, the bass player, did he ever play with you in that band? Eddie Dorsey. Yeah, or was he at the Entertainers, I believe? Eddie Dorsey.
